repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR checks if the volume dropped (v1 - v2 >= 20), but the JoI script checks if it rose (v2 - v1 >= 20). Evidence F2 shows the JoI fired an action when the volume was held constant at 20, which implies the subtraction order was inverted, causing a false positive. The operands must match the IR's subtraction direction.
diagnosis.change_summary: Reversed the subtraction order in the if-condition from (v2 - v1) to (v1 - v2) to match the IR specification. This ensures the action triggers only when the volume decreases by 20 or more.
